summary: Iter 113 — Tested P05 audit fixes + new features (Cetak Label Anak, Pilih Baris PO, Laporan Hutang Reimburse). BACKEND (10 passed, 1 env-skip) via /app/backend/tests/test_iter113_p05_new_features.py: (a) GET /api/cash-advance-settlements/reimburse-payables — admin 200, warehouse 403; synthetic seed of 4 posted_to_gl + open settlements (0-7/8-14/15-30/>30 buckets, TEST_EmpA 350k/TEST_EmpB 900k) is aggregated correctly, excluded rows (submitted / hutang_reimburse.status=paid) don't leak. (b) GET /api/purchase-orders/{po}/billing-context returns po_line_id (Ln), line_no, same_product_lines, line_code (LINI, e.g. 'woven'), already_billed_qty, billable_received per line; ensure_line_ids persists items[].line_id on PO doc. FN-02 regression verified: synthetic PO with two DIFFERENT products sharing line_code='woven' → distinct po_line_id, per-line billable_received (50/80), per-line po_price (10/20), same_product_lines=1 each — NO cross-billing/price sharing. (c) POST /api/vendor-bills validation: same product on >1 PO lines w/o po_line_id → 400; duplicate po_line_id in one bill → 400. (d) GET /api/inventory/cut-children-unverified items contain product_name/sku/parent_roll_no/ref_number. (e) GET /api/finance/balance-sheet no as_of → as_of == today (excludes future JEs). (f) GET /api/finance/cash-flow → method='journal_cash_classification', noncash_disclosure present, reconciled=true. (g) GET /api/finance/consolidation/summary is read-only (intercompany_eliminations count unchanged). (h) POST /api/gl/journal (manual, global account 1-1100) → 200. P05 conflict tests (approve vs reject 409, void closed period 409, void twice 400) are already covered by /app/audit/iterations/2026-10-05-P05-coa-reports-close/repro_p05.py (29/29). Period-unlock HTTP conflict test skipped in this env because no closed period matches the synthetic period_key — the invariant is already covered service-side by repro_p05.py IX-08. FRONTEND (Playwright, admin login): ?view=reimburse-payables&entity=ent_ksc renders reimburse-payables-view + rp-total + rp-bucket-0-7/8-14/15-30/gt30 + rp-refresh + rp-empty; ?view=wms-locations renders lp-tab-cuts + lp-tab-pa, clicking lp-tab-cuts renders pending-cuts-panel; ?view=vendor-bills → 'Buat Tagihan' opens vendor-bill-create-modal with vb-po-select showing 10 PO options — after selecting KSC/PO-00015 modal shows Baris #1 badge (vb-item-line-0), vb-item-remaining-0, PO price Rp 157.500, Match Bersih badge, and Simpan Draf (vb-save-draft); ?view=financial-statements → fs-tab-cf clickable and renders CashFlowTab with 'Terekonsiliasi' badge + cf-noncash disclosure box (1-2900 Akumulasi Penyusutan / 3-2900 Ekuitas Saldo Awal) — matches backend noncash_disclosure contract. No regressions on sidebar / detail LPJ / cuts panel. All synthetic docs (audit_iter113 prefix + stl_iter113_* + po_iter113_*) cleaned in fixture teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: cash_advance_service.reimburse_payables: correctly filters status==posted_to_gl AND hutang_reimburse.status==open; buckets 0-7/8-14/15-30/>30 with age from approved_at; per-employee aggregation and items list match ReimbursePayablesView expectations.
vendor_bill_service.ensure_line_ids assigns permanent Ln ids (idempotent) and persists back to purchase_orders.items[].line_id — prevents cross-billing regressions when items reorder.
vendor_bill_service.line_key correctly resolves per-line via po_line_id; falls back to po_line_code only when unique — two different products with same line_code (lini) never share a key.
routers/vendor_bills create_bill: strict ambiguity guards (400) for missing po_line_id on multi-line product + duplicate po_line_id in same bill; atomic_claim per PO prevents concurrent bill posting.
financial_statements /balance-sheet default as_of clamps to today; cash_flow returns method='journal_cash_classification' with noncash_disclosure and reconciled=true (verified via HTTP).
consolidation_service.summary is read-only — verified count of intercompany_eliminations unchanged after summary call.
